name: Grilled sweet potato
summary: Khoai lang nướng is sweet potato roasted on the grill at the Silver Waterfall tree stalls, beside the corn and eggs.
origin: Sa Pa, at the Silver Waterfall stalls.
howToEat: Buy one with the corn and eggs as a snack after the falls walk.
where: The tree stalls under Silver Waterfall, about 12 km from town toward Ô Quy Hồ.
seoTitle: Grilled sweet potato in Sapa — the falls stalls
seoDescription: Khoai lang nướng on the grill at the Silver Waterfall tree stalls, beside corn and eggs.
